title: Top-level Only Definitions
description: Definitions in repo are just top-level. They start on a newline and declaration/statements inside, dont count as definition. E.g. in python in semio.py __str__ is wrongly being identified as definition
summary: Anchored definition regexes for Python, Rust, C#, and Shell to enforce top-level only definitions in the repo tool. Updated documentation in AGENTS.md and README.md.
